video_metadata.title: 4H Bias Continuation Setup — Short Example on MES

input.transcript_snippet: Let me walk you through this short setup. My 4-hour chart is bearish — we're below the 4H FVG so bias is down. I drop to the 15-minute and I see a bearish CHoCH, change of character, so 15-minute structure confirms bearish too. I come to the 5-minute and I'm waiting for a fair value gap to form. When price retraces into that bearish FVG during the New York morning session, that's my short entry. I target previous equal lows as my take profit. I don't trade on FOMC or CPI days — the noise is too unpredictable. When the 4-hour is bullish I flip it to go long — exact same mechanics. My win rate on this is roughly 68 percent over the last 300 trades.
